title: Moving Slowly (wet clothes, muscles aren’t working, trudging through mud)

classification.question_topic: Whether dream movement slowness/flying restrictions in MallWorld are intentional (moderators/creators) and whether others experience this
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream episode with locations; general discussion/questions about common dream mechanics (slow running, being chased, difficulty flying).

meta.author_theory: Mentions idea of MallWorld “moderators”/“creators” possibly restricting dream speed/flying; asks if being slowed is intentional and whether one must get caught or can learn to speed up/break through restrictions.

interactions.description: Generalized recurring dream mechanic described: trying to run away from something chasing them, but moving very slowly; the closer the chaser gets, the slower movement becomes; sometimes ends in death or waking up before being caught.

entities_involved.description: Something or someone chasing/approaching with negative intention (unspecified).

interactions.description: Generalized attempt to fly in dreams: has only been able to fly two times; has tried countless times and it almost never works; if they try, it may be restricted or they wake up.
